name: ai-impact
description: Scaling AI activity into business impact. Thinking tools your own AI agent runs with you against your real portfolio — some reflection, some working a number through until it fits your system, some diagnosis. Start at ai-activity-to-impact to find which constraint is actually in the way; it routes you to the rest. They ask rather than answer, and each ends in one experiment to run.

plugins.name: ai-impact
plugins.description: Turn AI activity into business impact with your own agent and your own material. Locate whether you are at activity, output or impact and find the constraint the result is waiting on — then work the specific thing: initiative readiness, portfolio patterns, outcome framing, flow metrics, WIP limits once agents write the code. Conversational, ending in an experiment rather than a score.
